title: Field notes
subtitle: A folio for close observation
deck: A quiet cover gives a small circle room to grow. Inside, the same field becomes a place to notice, draw and return.
construction: The folio is drawn as two covers joined along a single left edge. A thin stack of pages sits behind the front face. Opening that face reveals the inside while the hinge stays in place.
note: A circle crosses the edge of the cover, suggesting a view that continues beyond the page. The warm orange interrupts the moss field; a fine offset ring gives the composition a second, quieter boundary. These are original digital design decisions, not photographs of a manufactured object.
